inset.$description: The gap between the screen's top edge and the header's pill.

bar.$description: SiteHeader's pill from sm up: 0.75rem padding around a 2.25rem row of controls.

height.$description: The whole header from sm up: what a fixed sidebar below it starts after.

gap.$description: The breathing room an in-page jump leaves below a stuck header.

offset.$description: Where an in-page jump stops below a stuck header: the page's scroll padding and www's section scroll margins (96 px).

max-width.$description: The pill's widest: it centres inside the header from there.
